reviewFindings: HIGH: peerDependencies['@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'] = '0.1.7-alpha.1 || 0.1.7-alpha.2 || 0.1.7-rc.1 || 0.1.7-rc.2' does not admit 0.2.1-rc.5; with no engines.dsh present the rc.5 preflight evaluates exactly this peer and DISABLES the whole plugin (throw in loadProfileDirectory, row.disabled in preflight). The plugin cannot even load on rc.5 without a manual exact-version exemption.

HIGH: inject=['tools','agents','connection'] is a STATIC inject. Neither dsh-base nor dsh-headless supplies 'connection' (it is only in dsh-web-app). In the headless profile the plugin stays unresolved/PENDING instead of degrading to Standalone; the notification/tool core never mounts.

MEDIUM: engines declares only node>=22 with no engines.dsh. Per app-boot, an own engines.dsh range would decide alone and silence peer evaluation; the fix options are mutually exclusive (add engines.dsh, or repoint the dsh-session peer) — this is a deliberate design choice for T02, documented not decided here.

MEDIUM: dshWorkshop.compatibility.dshVersions and docs/compatibility-matrix.md still list the 0.1.7-* family; verify-host-compat.mjs enforces that peer range, verified matrix rows, and dshVersions are mutually consistent, so all three must move together or the guard fails.

MEDIUM: peerDependencies['@deepseek-ai/cordis']='^4.0.1' vs rc.5's vendored cordis 4.0.5. Semver-satisfied by 4.0.5 and ignored by the dsh preflight, but the plugin's declared range no longer reflects the shipped runtime family; aligning to '~4.0.5' would match dsh-base's own declaration.

LOW: cordis.patch.yml row sets admin.enabled=true by default. On headless/rc.5 the admin HTTP surface depends on webServer being present; the patch row itself is profile-agnostic but the behavior claim should be re-verified in T02/T19.

LOW: plugin tool 'notify' execute(rawArgs, execContext) only reads execContext.agent/session for routing and ignores execContext.signal; rc.5 supplies exec.signal (dsh-tools lib/index.js:1531). Cancel propagation is a T10 item, recorded here as an rc.5 seam that exists but is unused.
